Title: MentionBird Review - AI Visibility Tracking With a Fix Plan
# MentionBird Review - AI Visibility Tracking With a Fix Plan. A few months ago I asked ChatGPT for recommendations in a category I know well, and it named three brands. Two were competitors, one was a brand I had never heard of, and the company I had been doing SEO for was nowhere in the answer. That gap is what MentionBird is built around. It is an AI visibility tool that runs your buyer questions through ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and four other assistants every day, shows you which sources those answers were built from, and then hands you a per prompt plan for getting your brand into them. I spent time going through the product pages, the pricing page, the help content and the free tools before writing this review. Everything below comes from what MentionBird actually documents about how the product behaves, plus my read on where it fits and where it does not. No hands on trial here, since MentionBird does not offer one, so treat this as an informed read of the product rather than a lab test. ## What MentionBird Is. MentionBird is an AI visibility (sometimes called AEO or GEO) platform made by ADNABU PTE. It does two things that most tools in this space only do one of:. 1. **Prompt tracking**: you give it the questions buyers ask before they buy, and it asks those questions on the AI platforms you pick, every 24 hours, then records which brands got named, how high they appeared, and which sources were cited. 2. **AI Ranking Advice**: for any prompt you are losing, an agent reads that specific answer, pulls the sources behind it, and returns a plan with effort estimates and links to the pages it used. MentionBird states it plainly on the homepage: other AI visibility trackers show you a chart of mentions and leave the "now what?" to you. If your brand is not one of them, you were not in the running, and no analytics package will ever show you the lost visit. * **Every answer has sources.** Recommendation answers are built from a small set of pages, reviews and videos the model trusts for that specific question.
